readings: Start from the observatories table, so observatories with zero telescopes count as observatories with a telescope count of 0 and a share of 0. For each observatory station, count its telescopes. Its share is that count divided by the total number of telescopes. The average share is taken across all observatories in the observatories table, including those with no telescopes. Keep only observatories whose share is strictly above that average. For each, list `observstation`, the telescope count, the share, and share minus average share, with no rounding. Sort by the difference from largest to smallest and return exactly the first 10 rows. If observatories tie at 10th place, pick any of them.

Consider only observatory stations that have at least one telescope in the telescopes table. Observatories with no telescopes are ignored. For each such station, count its telescopes. Its share is that count divided by the total number of telescopes. The average share is taken only across those stations that have telescopes. Keep only stations whose share is strictly above that average. For each, list `observstation`, the telescope count, the share, and share minus average share, with no rounding. Sort by the difference from largest to smallest and return exactly the first 10 rows. If stations tie at 10th place, pick any of them.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation AS observstation,
         COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares
)
SELECT s.observstation, s.cnt AS telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS diff_from_avg
FROM shares s, avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
